_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is engaged in the discovery, development, licensing, manufacturing, marketing, distribution and sale of pharmaceutical and nutritional products.' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1); 'Our Pharmaceuticals Segment is confronted by a record level of industry patent expirations and increasingly aggressive generic competition.' (Item 1A); 'In 2008, net sales of PLAVIX* contributed $5.6 billion, representing 27% of total net sales' (Item 1A); 'It is possible that the Company may lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -54.1%/yr (worst year FY02-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.5%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.3-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.5%/yr (FY02-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +60.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2009-04-17) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.38x (75.8% downside to Bear $5 / +200.0% upside to Bull $62) | Adj composite 3.30 vs market 1.50: gap +1.80 [UNDERVALUED] | -27% above the EPP floor $28 (17x FY09E $1.66) | Conservative 2-yr case: +108.4% total (+54.2%/yr) | At 12.5x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $27 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +11.0% in Q4 2008, forward revenues +8% (no FY09 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2008 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
